latest_cos_commentary.headline: Vox AI is an Amsterdam-founded, venture-backed autonomous voice-AI vendor targeting QSR drive-thru and mobile ordering, positioned as a no-hardware-change POS integration layer.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's kitchen_drive_thru line by offering autonomous voice ordering that sits on top of a restaurant's existing POS rather than replacing it, positioning itself as an add-on rather than a full POS replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Freshly capitalized (seed round closed August 2025) and actively expanding into the US market with a new San Francisco office, suggesting an active US sales push in the near term.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect mentions evaluating voice-AI drive-thru add-ons, confirm whether Vox AI is one of the vendors under review and note it claims POS-agnostic integration without new hardware; ask for named reference accounts since none are public.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers are publicly confirmed; ROI and accuracy claims are vendor-reported. Company scale (headcount, total deployed locations) is not disclosed.

verification_needed: named restaurant chain customers or pilots (only described as 'major global chains,' unnamed)
